headline: Wendy's Rejects Unsolicited One Point Four Billion Dollar Takeover Bid
summary: Wendy's rebuffed an unsolicited $1.4 billion hostile takeover bid from Trian Partners, led by activist investor Nelson Peltz, alongside another group of investment firms.
why: Hostile takeover bids for consumer dining chains signal active corporate restructuring and private equity interest in the restaurant sector, driving short-term volatility in target shares.

impacts.name: Wendy's Co
impacts.why: Wendy's rejected a $1.4 billion acquisition proposal from Trian Partners and investor groups.
